entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transfer EMM mode from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode, establish radio and S1 bearers for user data or signalling, invoke CS fallback procedures, and handle various UE-initiated requests.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure, starting timer T3417.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message used for 1xCS fallback in service request procedure, starting timer T3417.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject service request, stopping timer T3417.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM mode where UE is not actively connected, requiring service request to transition to EMM-CONNECTED.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM mode where UE has active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: T3417
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST or EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST, stopped upon receiving response or AS indication.

entities.name: UE in EMM-IDLE mode has pending user data
entities.description: Condition triggering service request when UE in EMM-IDLE mode has uplink user data pending.

entities.name: Paging request with CN domain indicator PS
entities.description: Condition where UE in EMM-IDLE mode receives paging request with CN domain indicator set to PS, triggering service request.

entities.name: Mobile originating CS fallback request
entities.description: Condition where UE configured for CS fallback receives request from upper layer, triggering service request.

entities.name: EMM mode transition to EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: System behavior where service request procedure transitions UE from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: Radio and S1 bearer establishment
entities.description: System behavior where service request procedure establishes radio and S1 bearers for user data or signalling.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure includes sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST for 1xCS fallback.
Sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST starts timer T3417.
Sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST starts timer T3417.
Receiving SERVICE REJECT stops timer T3417.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE mode for certain triggers.
Condition of pending user data in EMM-IDLE mode guards invocation of service request procedure.
Condition of paging with CN domain indicator PS guards invocation of service request procedure.
Condition of CS fallback request guards invocation of service request procedure.
Service request procedure establishes transition from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Service request procedure establishes radio and S1 bearers for data transfer.
